contradiction_3_root_cause_and_witness.c_r1_human_report_claim: 5 / 6 naive 10x/15x scenarios suffer forced Mark liquidation before strategy stop; 7 / 6 suffer isolated margin bankruptcy deficits on the 9.5%-10% stop gap.
contradiction_3_root_cause_and_witness.exact_explanation: In risk_envelope.py lines 228-232, `naive_10x_15x` filters `scenarios` for `sizing_mode == 'NAIVE_FULL_LEVERAGE_NOTIONAL' and leverage in (10.0, 15.0) and not partial_tp1_before_shock`. That filter matches 10 scenarios out of 32 (6 from Loop 1 `SYN_LEV_*` + 4 from Loop 2 `SYN_PARTIAL_TP1_*_TP1_0`), NOT 6! Across those 10 scenarios, 5 (all five 15x scenarios) have `mark_liquidated_before_strategy_stop=True` (5/10), and 7 (all five 15x scenarios plus two 10x Loop-2 scenarios with 10% gap) have `isolated_margin_bankruptcy_deficit_usdt < 0` (7/10). C R1's `run.py` hardcoded `/ 6` in the Markdown template, producing `5 / 6` and the mathematically impossible `7 / 6`.
contradiction_3_root_cause_and_witness.discretionary_margin_topup_finding: In C R1's `RISK_BUDGET_CAPPED_ISOLATED` mode (lines 91-96 of risk_envelope.py), `initial_margin_posted` was set to `max(N / L, N * per_unit_risk_frac)` (~11.46%-12.06% of notional), which adds a discretionary margin buffer above `N / L` and lowers effective isolated leverage on 15x scenarios to ~8.29x-8.72x. When evaluated at strict exchange initial margin `M0 = N / L` (6.67% at 15x), all 3 of the 15x risk-capped scenarios (`SYN_LEV_15X_MMR_40BP_RISK_`, `SYN_LEV_15X_MMR_50BP_RISK_`, `SYN_LEV_15X_MMR_100BP_RISK_`) STILL liquidate on the 6.8% Mark shock (`3/6` of risk-capped 10x/15x scenarios).
contradiction_3_root_cause_and_witness.ieee754_float_lot_floor_drift_finding: On the 7 15x naive scenarios (`target_notional = 950.0 * 15.0 = 14250.0`, `entry_price = 30000.0`), exact Decimal lot sizing is `14250 / 30000 = 0.475` BTC (`14,250.0` USDT notional, `950.0` USDT margin), whereas C R1's float expression `math.floor((14250.0 / 30000.0) / 0.001) * 0.001` evaluated `0.475 / 0.001` as `474.99999999999994` in IEEE-754 binary float, truncating to `0.474` BTC (`14,220.0` USDT notional).
